FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\700 - 800 IOG\766 IOG - Death of Aelius, Puli Ailushi Libisai.md
========================================

---
title: 766 IOG - Death of Aelius, Puli Ailushi Libisai
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|4th of Flami 766 IOG]], [[Aelius|Puli Ailushi Libisai]], died at [[Shiki]], he claimed this is where he wished to die, looking out to the [[Moli Ikozinao]]. Historians of the time (such as [[Kitii]]) claimed that it was his wife that poisoned him. This is unlikely however as it was likely a ploy to discredit [[Atrinoki Rai Puli Ailushi|Atrinoki]] and she was often the target of false gossip. It is also known that in the months prior that Ailushi's health had been declining and he was in the process of preparing a smooth transition of power to his son, Atrinoki.

His last words were
> If my flame had burned bright, celebrate my successes.

In the days following an enormous procession of mourners, both common and noble, travelled with his body from [[Shiki]] to [[Solaum]]; all business was closed on the day of his funeral. Atrinoki and his son, Ailushi's grandson, [[Harisi]], delivered the eulogy while standing atop two _rostra_. His body was coffin bound and was cremated in front of the [[Obelisk of Origin]]. His ashes were collected into an urn and was placed in the [[Mausoleum of Ailuhsi]], in the imperial district of Solaum.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\700 - 800 IOG\766 IOG - Senate Grants Atrinoki the Powers of the Prinosum Solauni.md
========================================

---
title: 766 IOG - Senate Grants Atrinoki the Powers of the Prinosum Solauni
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|5th of Atmi 766 IOG]], [[Atrinoki Rai Puli Ailushi|Atrinoki]] called the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] in order to validate his position as _Prinosum Solauni_, and, as had [[Aelius|Ailushi]] before him, grant himself its powers. Atrinoki already had the administrative and political powers of the _Princeps_, but he lacked the titles of _[[Ailushi]]_ and _[[Bari Kirok]]_ ("Father of the country"). Like Ailushi before him, Atrinoki may have sought to represent himself as a reluctant yet devoted public servant, no more than an ordinary citizen who wanted to serve the state and people to the best of his ability, but his refusal of these titular, quasi-religious honours, and his reluctance to accept the full powers of a _Prinosum Solauni_ were taken as insults to the elite who offered them; signs of hypocrisy, not humility. Antagonism between Atrinoki and his senate seems to have been a feature of his rule. In his first few years as emperor, Atrinoki seems to have wanted the Senate to act alone, with no reference to him or his responsibilities as "first Senator". His direct orders were rather vague, inspiring debates on what he actually meant, rather than passing his legislation.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\700 - 800 IOG\789 IOG - Death of Atrinoki.md
========================================

---
title: 789 IOG - Death of Atrinoki
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Atrinoki Rai Puli Ailushi|Atrinoki]] died in [[Shiki]], like his adoptive father, on [[Dating|16th of Narimi 789 IOG]], months before his 78th birthday.

[[Kitii]] relates that the emperor appeared to have stopped breathing, and that [[Rai Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Garikili]], who was at [[Atrinoki Rai Puli Ailushi|Atrinoki]]'s villa, was being congratulated on his succession to the empire, when news arrived that the emperor had revived and was recovering his faculties. He goes on to report that those who had moments before recognized Garikili as [[Ailushi]] fled in fear of the emperor's wrath, while a member of the [[Solaris Vanguard]] took advantage of the chaos to have Atrinoki smothered with his own bedclothes.

After his death, the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] refused to vote Atrinoki the divine honours that had been paid to [[Aelius|Ailushi]], and mobs filled the streets yelling "To the [[Atri]] with Atrinoki!" (the bodies of criminals were typically thrown into the river, instead of being buried or burnt). However, the emperor was cremated, and his ashes were placed in the [[Mausoleum of Ailuhsi]].

In his will, Atrinoki nominated Garikili and [[Atrinoki Rai Puli Mari|Atrinoki Gamaniri]] as his joint heirs. Garikili's first act on becoming _Prinosum Solauni_ was to void Atrinoki's will.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\700 - 800 IOG\789 IOG - Garikili Ascends to Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 789 IOG - Garikili Ascends to Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Atrinoki Rai Puli Ailushi|Atrinoki]] died on [[Dating|16th of Narimi 789 IOG]], a day before an important religious festival. He was 77. Many historical authors repeated rumours that [[Rai Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Garikili]] was directly responsible for his death. On the same day, Garikili was hailed as emperor by members of the [[Solaris Vanguard]] at [[Shiki]]. His leadership of the house of [[Ailushi Dynasty|Ailushi]] as its sole heir and father of the family was ratified by the [[Senate of Solara]], who proclaimed him [[Ailushi]] on the 18th of Narimi 789 IOG. Garikili entered Rome on 28 Narimi, and with the consensus of "the three orders" (senate, equestrians and common citizens) the Senate conferred on him the "right and power to decide on all affairs". Garikili was the first emperor to acquire all of his powers at once rather than over the course of his reign like [[Aelius|Ailushi]] and Atrinoki.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\700 - 800 IOG\793 IOG - Assassination of Garikili.md
========================================

---
title: 793 IOG - Assassination of Garikili
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|21st of Hanomi 793 IOG]], the day before his due departure for [[Admorru]], [[Rai Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Garikili]] was assassinated by several [[Rikati]]. Historians of the time name many of his inner circle as conspirators in the assassination. The [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] was a disunited body of self-interested, wealthy and mistrustful aristocrats, unwilling to risk their own prospects, and determined to present a virtuous, united front.

The Senate tried to use Garikili's death as an opportunity to restore the Republic of [[Solara]]. This would have meant the abolition of the office of emperor, the end of dynastic rule, and restoration of the former social stature and privilege of nobles and senators. Most ordinary citizens were taken aback by Garikili's murder, and found no cause to celebrate in losing the benefits of his rule. Almost all the named conspirators were from the elite.

The assassins, fearing continued support for Garikili's family and allies, sought out and murdered Garikili's wife, and their young daughter, but were unable to reach his uncle [[Atrinoki Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Grudikali]]. A sympathetic faction of the [[Solaris Vanguard]] smuggled him out to their nearby camp, and nominated him as emperor. The Senate, faced with what now seemed inevitable, confirmed their choice.

The killing of Garikili had been extralegal, tantamount to regicide, and those who carried it out had broken their oaths of loyalty to him.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\700 - 800 IOG\793 IOG - Grudikali Becomes Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 793 IOG - Grudikali Becomes Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|21st of Hanomi 793 IOG]], [[Rai Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Garikili]] was [[793 IOG - Assassination of Garikili|assassinated in a conspiracy]] involving a member of the [[Solaris Vanguard]] and several [[Senate of Solara|senators]]. In the chaos following the murder, [[Atrinoki Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Grudikali]] witnessed the [[Freidburg Guard]] cut down several uninvolved noblemen, including many of his friends. He fled to the palace to hide. A member of the [[Solaris Vanguard]] found him and proclaimed him [[Prinosum Solauni]]. Grudikali was spirited away to the camp of the Solaris Vanguard and put under their protection.

The Senate met and debated a change of government, but this devolved into an argument over which of them would be the new _Prinosum Solauni_. When they heard of the Vanguards' claim, they demanded that Grudikali be delivered to them for approval, but he refused, sensing the danger that would come with complying. Eventually the Senate was forced to give in. In return, Grudikali granted a general amnesty, although he executed a few junior officers involved in the conspiracy. The actual assassins, were put to death to ensure Grudikali's own safety and as a future deterrent.

Since Grudikali was the first emperor proclaimed on the initiative of the Solaris Vanguard instead of the Senate, his repute suffered at the hands of commentators.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\806 IOG - Death of Grudikali.md
========================================

---
title: 806 IOG - Death of Grudikali
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Atrinoki Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki]] was poisoned, possibly contained in mushrooms or on a feather to induce vomiting, and died in the early hours of [[Dating|3rd of Irnumi 806 IOG]]. Nearly all implicate his final and powerful wife as the instigator. Him as his wife had become more combative in the months leading up to his death. This carried on to the point where Grudikali openly lamented his bad wives, and began to comment on his son approaching manhood with an eye towards restoring his status within the imperial family.

Claudius's ashes were interred in the [[Mausoleum of Ailuhsi]] on 14th of Irnumi 806 IOG, after a funeral similar to that of his great-uncle [[Aelius|Ailushi]] 40 years earlier.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\806 IOG - Mari Ascends to Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 806 IOG - Mari Ascends to Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Mari Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Mari]] becomes emperor on [[Dating|3rd of Irnumi 806]] at age 16. His tutor, [[Labisi Amishi Shinaki|Shinaki]], prepared Mari's first speech before the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]]. During this speech, Mari spoke about "eliminating the ills of the previous regime". His respect for Senatorial autonomy, which distinguished him from [[Rai Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Garikili]] and [[Atrinoki Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Grudikali]], was generally well received by the Solari Senate.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\820 IOG - Death of Emperor Mari.md
========================================

---
title: 820 IOG - Death of Emperor Mari
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|17th of Garimi 820 IOG]], Emperor [[Mari Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Mari]] commits suicide by means of assisted suicide through his private secretary.

The night before Mari had returned to [[Solaum]] and spent the evening in the palace. After sleeping, he awoke at about midnight to find the palace guard had left. Dispatching messages to his friends' palace chambers for them to come, he received no answers. Upon going to their chambers personally, he found them all abandoned. When he called for a gladiator or anyone else adept with a sword to kill him, no one appeared. He cried, "Have I neither friend nor foe?" and ran out as if to throw himself into the [[Atri]]. Returning, Mari sought a place where he could hide and collect his thoughts. An imperial freedman, Zaoni, offered his villa, 6.5 km outside the city. Travelling in disguise, Mari and four loyal freedmen reached the villa, whereupon Mari ordered them to dig a grave for him. At this time, Mari learned that the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] had declared him a public enemy. Mari prepared himself for suicide, pacing up and down muttering. Losing his nerve, he begged one of his companions to set an example by killing himself first. At last, the sound of approaching horsemen drove Mari to face the end as he ordered his private secretary to kill him.

When one of the horsemen entered and saw that Mari was dying, he attempted to stop the bleeding, but efforts to save Mari's life were unsuccessful. Mari's final words were "Too late! This is fidelity!" With Mari's death, the [[Ailushi Dynasty]] ended. Chaos would ensue in the Year of the Four Emperors.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\820 IOG - Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi is Proclaimed Emperor.md
========================================

---
title: 820 IOG - Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi is Proclaimed Emperor
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|4th of Narimi 820 IOG]], the governor of [[Dulagi Ranbartia]], rebelled against [[Mari Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Mari]]'s tax policies. The governor of [[Fraidkiri Makosa]], was ordered to put down the rebellion. In an attempt to gain support from outside his own province, the governor of Dulagi Ranbartia called upon [[Anparashi Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi Puli Ailushi|Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi]], the governor of [[Agrisi Agosika]], to join the rebellion and to declare himself emperor in opposition to Mari.

At the [[Battle of Darzai]] on the 9th of Gamami 820 IOG, The forces from Fraidkiri Makosa easily defeated those of Dulagi Ranbartia, and the governor committed suicide. However, after defeating the rebel, the legions attempted to proclaim their own commander as Emperor. The governor of Fraidkiri refused to act against Mari, but the discontent of the legions of Fraidiki and the continued opposition of Kalpi in Agrisi did not bode well for him. While Mari had retained some control of the situation, support for Kalpi increased despite his being officially declared a "public enemy". The prefect of the [[Solaris Vanguard]], also abandoned his allegiance to the Emperor and came out in support of Kalpi.

In response, Mari fled [[Solaum]] with the intention of going to the port of [[Polbaridaco]] and, from there, to take a fleet to one of the still-loyal eastern provinces. According to a historian, Mari abandoned the idea when some army officers openly refused to flee with him. Mari then toyed with the idea of fleeing to [[Setting/Nations/Echeh|Echeh]], throwing himself upon the mercy of Kalpi, or appealing to the people and begging them to pardon him for his past offences "and if he could not soften their hearts, to entreat them at least to allow him the [[Prefecture of Admorru|prefecture of Admorru]]".

On the 15th of Garimi 820 IOG, Kalpi, in rebellion against Mari, rejected the title "General of [[Puli]]" in favour of "General of The [[Senate of Solara]] and People of [[Solaum]]". He was supported by the imperial official, the prefect of the Solaris Vanguard. At midnight on 16th of Garimi, another imperial official, falsely announced to the Solaris Vanguard that Mari had fled to Admorru, and the Senate proclaimed Kalpi emperor. In this process he changed his name from *Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi* to *Anparashi Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi Puli Ailushi* (meaning Emperor Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi Puli Ailushi).

FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\821 IOG - Death of Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi.md
========================================

---
title: 821 IOG - Death of Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the 1st of Hanomi 821 IOG, the day [[Anparashi Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi Puli Ailushi|Kalpi]] and his co-consul took office, the fourth and twenty-second [[Rikati]] of [[Fraidkiri Makosa]] refused to swear loyalty to Kalpi. They toppled his statues, demanding that a new emperor be chosen. On the following day, the soldiers of [[Fraidkiri Pauri]] also refused to swear their loyalty and proclaimed the governor of the province, [[Atni Badipora Fraidaki Anparashi Ailushi|Atni Badipora]], as emperor. Galba tried to ensure his authority as emperor was recognised by adopting the a nobleman as his successor. Nevertheless, Kalpi was killed by the [[Solaris Vanguard]] on 15th Hanomi. [[Anparashi Nariai Muii Puli Ailushi|Muii]] was angry that he had been passed over for adoption, and organised a conspiracy with a small number of the Solaris Vanguard to murder the aged emperor and elevate himself. The soldiery in the capital, composed not just of members of the Solaris Vanguard but of Kalpi's legion from [[Agrisi]] and several detachments of men from the Solari fleet, [[Ulaluri]], [[Butiani]], and [[Fraidkiri]], were angered at not having received a donative. They also resented Kalpi's purges of their officers and fellow soldiers (this was especially true of the men from the fleet). Many in the Solaris Vanguard were shaken by the recent murder of their Prefect - some of the waverers were convinced to come over to Muii's side out of fear Kalpi might yet take revenge on them for their connection to him.

Kalpi put on a linen corset although remarking it was little protection against so many swords; when a soldier claimed to have killed Muii, Kalpi snapped "On what authority?". He was lured out to the scene of his assassination in the Forum by a false report of the conspirators. Kalpi either tried to buy his life with a promise of the withheld bounty or asked that he be beheaded. The only help for him was a centurion in the Solaris Vanguard, who was killed trying to defend Kalpi with a pugio; one hundred and twenty persons later petitioned Muii that they had killed Kalpi; they would be executed. A company of Freidburg soldiers to whom he had once done a kindness rushed to help him; however they took a wrong turn and arrived too late.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\821 IOG - Kondobonioki Overthrows Badipora to Become Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 821 IOG - Kondobonioki Overthrows Badipora to Become Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

In [[Dating|Ebolumi 821 IOG]], [[Atni Badipora Fraidaki Anparashi Ailushi|Badipora]] learns that the armies of the eastern provinces had proclaimed a rival emperor: their commander, [[Anparashi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Tidi Bralosai Kondobonioki]]. As soon as it was known that the armies of the East had declared for Kondobonioki, Badipora sent several legions to prevent the Eastern armies from entering [[Asheri]], but the commander, dissatisfied with Badipora's poor administration, attempted without success to defect to Kondobonioki. This undermined the morale of the Badiporan [[Rikati]], and they were decisively defeated at the [[821 IOG - Battle of Viguntasto|Second Battle of Viguntasto]]. Another commander was then sent by Badipora to rally supporting armies in [[Dulagi]], but forces loyal to Kondobonioki captured and executed him soon after. Badipora, now deserted by many of his adherents, prepared to abdicate the title of emperor.

[[Kitii]] recounts that Badipora awaited Kondobonioki's army in a town near [[Condobonia]]. The terms of abdication had actually been agreed upon with the commander of the sixth Rikati serving in [[Argipia]] and one of Kondobonioki's chief supporters. However, as he was on his way to deposit the insignia of empire in the [[Temple of Danordia in Solaum|Temple]] of [[Danordia]] in Solaum, the [[Solaris Vanguard]] refused to allow him to carry out the agreement, and forced him to return to the palace.

On the entrance of Kondobonioki's troops into [[Solaum]], Badipora's supporters (mostly civilians) organized heavy resistance, resulting in a brutal battle. Entrenched on the city's buildings, they threw stones, javelins, and tiles on Kondobonioki's soldiers who consequently suffered heavy casualties in the urban fighting. 50,000 people died in the battle for Solaum. Large parts of the city were destroyed, including the [[Temple of Shuzi Makosa]]. Badipora was eventually dragged out of a hiding-place, driven to the [[Obelisk of Origin]], and there struck down by Kondobonioki's supporters. His body was thrown into the [[Atri]]. He was killed on the 15th of Shunmi 821 IOG.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\821 IOG - Muii Becomes Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 821 IOG - Muii Becomes Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Anparashi Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi Puli Ailushi|Kalpi]] was killed by the Solaris Vanguard on [[Dating|15th Hanomi 821 IOG]] followed by his allies shortly after. Their heads were placed on poles and [[Anparashi Nariai Muii Puli Ailushi]] was proclaimed emperor.

[[Mari Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Mari]]'s statues were again set up, his freedmen and household officers reinstalled. The populace acclaimed him as "Mari Muii", although Muii did not appear to like the title.

At the same time, the fears of the more sober and respectable citizens were relieved by Muii's liberal professions of his intention to govern equitably. He assumed the consulate of the year alongside his brother but only until the 1st of Narimi.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\821 IOG - Mulii Commits Suicide.md
========================================

---
title: 821 IOG - Mulii Commits Suicide
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Dating|On the 1dt of Narimi 821 IOG]], several legions had declared for [[Atni Badipora Fraidaki Anparashi Ailushi|Badipora]] and were already advancing upon [[Asheri]]. The conflict began in earnest when Badipora's forces crossed the [[Albi]] into northern Asheri. [[Anparashi Nariai Muii Puli Ailushi|Mulii]] dispatched forces, including veteran [[Rikati]], such as the [[Rikati XIV Gamana]], which had distinguished itself in the suppression of [[Epponina]]'s revolt in [[Butiani]].

The decisive engagement occurred at the [[821 IOG - Battle of Viguntasto|Battle of Viguntasto]] on 17th of Minumi 821 IOG. Despite initial successes by some Muliian units, including the capture of a Badiporan eagle standard, the battle resulted in a decisive defeat for Mulii's forces. The [[Solaris Vanguard]], core of Mulii's military strength, performed poorly in the engagement, fleeing before engaging in close combat.

Following the defeat, Mulii's remaining forces retreated to their camp at [[Viguntasto]]. Despite the urging of his soldiers to continue the fight and the approach of reinforcements from [[Ulaluri]], Mulii chose to end the civil war rather than subject the Solari people to further bloodshed. On 19th of Minumi 821 IOG, one day after the battle, Mulii committed suicide by stabbing himself with a dagger, stating that he could "die more honourably than he could reign." His death ended the war and cleared the path for Badipora to assume undisputed control of the empire.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\821 IOG - Solaran Empire is overtaken by Atni Badipora Fraidaki Anparashi Ailushi.md
========================================

---
title: 821 IOG - Solaran Empire is overtaken by Atni Badipora Fraidaki Anparashi Ailushi
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

Two [[Rikati]] refused to give their allegiance to Emperor [[Anparashi Sharini Zulbiti Kalpi Puli Ailushi|Kalpi]] on the [[Dating|1st of Hanomi 821 IOG]] and through these a military revolution was speedily accomplished. [[Atni Badipora Fraidaki Anparashi Ailushi|Badipora]] was proclaimed emperor at [[Rheingen]] on the following day, and then again on the day after. More accurately, he was proclaimed emperor of the armies of [[Fraidkiri Pauri]] and [[Fraidkiri Makosa|Makosa]]. The armies of [[Dulagi]], [[Butiani]] and [[Divikai]] sided with them shortly afterwards. By the time that they marched on [[Solaum]], however, it was [[Anparashi Nariai Muii Puli Ailushi|Mulii]], and not Kalpi, whom they had to confront.

In fact, he was never acknowledged as emperor by the entire Solari world, though at Solaum the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] accepted him and decreed to him the imperial honours on 22nd of Minumi, 821 IOG. He advanced into [[Asheri]] at the head of a licentious and rough soldiery, and Solaum became the scene of riot and massacre, gladiatorial shows and extravagant feasting. To reward his victorious [[Rikati]], Badipora expanded the existing [[Solaris Vanguard]] and installed his own men from his [[Freiburg]] army.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\821 IOG - The Senate of Solara Proclaims Kondobonioki Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 821 IOG - The Senate of Solara Proclaims Kondobonioki Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

In response to the disaster in [[Solaum]] [[Anparashi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Kondobioki]] sends grain from [[Admorru]] to Solaum in order to ease the affects of the recent battle, along with an edict assuring he would reverse the laws of [[Mari Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Mari]], especially those relating to treason.

He was the first emperor since [[Aelius|Ailushi]] to appear in [[Admorru]]. While there, he visited the Temple of Zarapi where he reportedly experienced a vision, and he performed healing miracles. He was hailed as pharaoh and proclaimed the son of the creator-deity Anim in the style of the ancient pharaohs, and an incarnation of Zarapi.

Kondobonioki was declared emperor by the [[Senate of Solara]] while he was in [[Admorru]] on [[Dating|16th of Shunmi 821 IOG]]; the Admorru had declared him emperor in the summer prior. In the short-term, administration of the empire was given to Mukiani, who was aided by Kondobonioki's son, [[Anparashi Puli Damashaoi Ailushi|Damashaoi]]. Mukiani started off Kondobonioki's rule with tax reform that was to restore the empire's finances. After Kondobonioki arrived in Solaum in mid-822 IOG, Mukiani continued to press Kondobonioki to collect as many taxes as possible.

Kondobonioki and Mukiani renewed old taxes and instituted new ones, increased the tribute of the provinces, and kept a watchful eye upon the treasury officials.

Kondobonioki founded the [[Bralosai Dynasty]] which was the second dynastic line to rule Solara, it consists of solely Kondobonioki and his two sons, Damashaoi and [[Anparashi Tidi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi]]. They ruled from 821 IOG - 848 IOG.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\821 IOG - Tidi Bralosai Kondobonioki is Proclaimed Emperor.md
========================================

---
title: 821 IOG - Tidi Bralosai Kondobonioki is Proclaimed Emperor
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|11th of Ebolumi 821 IOG]], [[Anparashi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Tidi Bralosai Kondobonioki]] is proclaimed emperor by various [[Rikati]] in the East as well as the prefect of [[Admorru]]. Upon ascension he adopts the name *Anparashi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi*.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\831 IOG - Kondobonioki Dies.md
========================================

---
title: 831 IOG - Kondobonioki Dies
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|3rd of Ebolumi 831 IOG]], [[Anparashi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Kondobonioki]], develops an illness in [[Cetum]], returning at once to [[Solaum]], and then he left for the hot-springs between [[Shiki]] and [[Solaum]], where he spent every summer. However, his illness worsened as he developed severe diarrhoea.

He could feel his life leaving his body, whence he said "An emperor ought to die standing," and struggled to his feet, he died in the arms of those helping him up.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\831 IOG - Tidi Ascends to the Throne of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 831 IOG - Tidi Ascends to the Throne of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Anparashi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi]] died of an infection on [[Dating|3rd of Ebolumi 831 IOG]], and was immediately succeeded by his son [[Anparashi Tidi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Tidi]]. He was the first Solari emperor to succeed his own biological father. Because of his many (alleged) vices, many Solari feared that he would be another [[Mari Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Mari]]. Against those expectations, however, Tidi proved to be an effective emperor and was well loved by the population, who praised him highly when they found that he possessed the greatest virtues, instead of vices.

One of his first acts as emperor was to order a halt to trials based on treason charges, which had long plagued the principate. The law of treason, or law of majestas, was originally intended to prosecute those who had corruptly "impaired the people and majesty of Solaum" by any revolutionary action. Under [[Aelius|Ailushi]], however, that custom had been revived and applied to cover slander and libel as well. This led to numerous trials and executions under [[Atrinoki Rai Puli Ailushi|Atrinoki]], [[Rai Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Garikili]], and Mari, and the formation of networks of informers, which terrorised Solara's political system for decades.

Titus put an end to that practice against himself or anyone else and declared:

>It is impossible for me to be insulted or abused in any way. For I do naught that deserves censure, and I care not for what is reported falsely.

Consequently, no [[Senate of Solara|senators]] were put to death during his reign; he thus kept to his promise that he would assume the office of [[Brili Shanmi]] "for the purpose of keeping his hands unstained". Informants were publicly punished and banished from the city. Tidi further prevented abuses by making it unlawful for a person to be tried under different laws for the same offense.

As emperor, he became known for his generosity.

Construction of the [[Bralosai Amphitheatre]] in [[Solaum]], was begun in 822 IOG under Kondobonioki and was finally completed in 832 IOG under Tidi. In addition to providing spectacular entertainments to the Roman populace, the building was also conceived as a gigantic triumphal monument.

The inaugural games lasted for a hundred days and were said to be extremely elaborate, including gladiatorial combat, fights between wild animals (elephants and cranes), mock naval battles for which the theatre was flooded, horse races and chariot races. During the games, wooden balls were dropped into the audience, inscribed with various prizes (clothing, gold, or even slaves), which could then be traded for the designated item.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\833 IOG - The Death of Tidi.md
========================================

---
title: 833 IOG - The Death of Tidi
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

To celebrate the construction of the [[Bralosai Amphitheatre]] in [[Dating|832 IOG]], [[Anparashi Tidi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Tidi]] hosted 100 days of games. At the closing of these games, in 833 IOG, Tidi officially dedicated the amphitheatre and the baths in what was his final recorded act as Emperor. He set out for the [[Vincum]] territories but fell ill at the first posting station. 

Tidi had ruled the Roman Empire for just over two years: from the death of his father in 831 IOG to his own on 1st of Atmi 833 IOG. He was succeeded by [[Anparashi Puli Damashaoi Ailushi|Damashaoi]], whose first act as emperor was to deify his brother.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\833 IOG - Throne of Solara is inherited by Damashaoi.md
========================================

---
title: 833 IOG - Throne of Solara is inherited by Damashaoi
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On [[Dating|1st of Atmi 833 IOG]], after barely two years in office, [[Anparashi Tidi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Tidi]], brother of [[Anparashi Puli Damashaoi Ailushi|Damashaoi]] unexpectedly died of fever during a trip to the [[Vincum]] territories. Ancient authors have implicated Damashaoi in the death of his brother, either by directly accusing him of murder, or implying he left the ailing Tidi for dead, even alleging that during his lifetime, Damashaoi was openly plotting against his brother. Brotherly affection was likely at a minimum, but this was hardly surprising, considering that Damashaoi had barely seen Tidi after the age of seven. Whatever the nature of their relationship, Damashaoi seems to have displayed little sympathy when his brother lay dying, instead making for the camp of the [[Solaris Vanguard]] where he was proclaimed emperor. The following day, 2nd of Atmi 833 IOG, the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] confirmed Damashaoi's powers, granting tribunician power, the office of [[Brili Shanmi]], and the titles of [[Ailushi]], and [[Bari Kirok]].


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\848 IOG - Damashaoi Is Assassinated.md
========================================

---
title: 848 IOG - Damashaoi Is Assassinated
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Anparashi Puli Damashaoi Ailushi|Damashaoi]] was assassinated on [[Dating|6th of Atmi 848 IOG]] in a conspiracy by court officials. Damashaoi's chamberlain played the main role in the plot, and his likely fear over Damashaoi's recent execution of [[Mari]]'s former secretary as a possible motive. The act itself was carried out by a freedman of the chamberlain's, and a steward of Damashaoi's niece. A number of omens had foretold Damashaoi's death.

According to an auspice he had received, the Emperor believed that his death would be at midday. As a result, he was always restless around that time. On the day of the assassination, Damashaoi was distressed and repeatedly asked a servant to tell him what time it was. The servant, who was himself one of the plotters, lied to the emperor, telling him that it was already late in the afternoon. Apparently put at ease, the Emperor went to his desk to sign some decrees. The chamberlain, who had been feigning an injury to his arm for several days and wearing a bandage to allow him to carry a concealed dagger, suddenly appeared and stabbed him eight times.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\848 IOG - Nariai Kagayai Mabosi Becomes Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 848 IOG - Nariai Kagayai Mabosi Becomes Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On [[Dating|6th of Atmi 848 IOG]], [[Anparashi Puli Damashaoi Ailushi|Damashaoi]] was assassinated in a palace conspiracy organised by court officials. On the very same day, records state that the [[Senate of Solara]] proclaimed [[Anparashi Mabosi Puli Ailushi|Nariai Kagayai Mabosi]] emperor, taking the name *Anparashi Mabosi Puli Ailushi*. This was the first time the Senate actually chose a new emperor rather than simply ratifying formally a choice made by either a previous emperor in his testament or an army or the [[Solaris Vanguard]]. Despite his political experience, this was a remarkable choice. Mabosi was old and childless, and had spent much of his career out of the public light, prompting both ancient and modern authors to speculate on his involvement in Damashaoi's assassination, although his probable lack of involvement would have made him acceptable to the Damashaoi faction.

Mabosi founded the [[Mabosi-Anatunoki Dynasty]], controlling Solara from 848 IOG to 944 IOG.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\850 IOG - Death of Mabosi.md
========================================

---
title: 850 IOG - Death of Mabosi
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On [[Dating|1st Hanomi 850 IOG]], at the start of his fourth consulship, [[Anparashi Mabosi Puli Ailushi|Mabosi]] suffered a stroke during a private audience. Shortly thereafter he was struck by a fever and died at his villa in the Gardens of Zarusti, on 24th of Hanomi 850 IOG. Mabosi was succeeded without incident by his adopted son [[Anparashi Puli Mabosi Floligaiki Ailushi|Floligaiki]], who was greeted by the Roman populace with much enthusiasm.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\850 IOG - Nariai Ulkos Floligaiki Ascends to the Throne of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 850 IOG - Nariai Ulkos Floligaiki Ascends to the Throne of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

As governor of [[Fraidkiri Makosa]] during [[Mabosi]]'s reign, [[Anparashi Puli Mabosi Floligaiki Ailushi|Floligaiki]] received the impressive title of _[[Fraidaki]]_ for his skilful management and rule of the volatile Imperial province. When [[Mabosi]] died on 24th of Hanomi 850 IOG, Floligaiki succeeded to the role of emperor without any outward adverse incident. The fact that he chose not to hasten towards [[Solaum]], but made a lengthy tour of inspection on the [[Schopbach]] and [[Boltachried]] frontiers, may suggest that he was unsure of his position, both in Rome and with the armies at the front. Alternatively, Floligaiki's keen military mind understood the importance of strengthening the empire's frontiers. His vision for future conquests required the diligent improvement of surveillance networks, defences and transport along the Boltachried. Prior to his frontier tours, Floligaiki ordered [[Solaris Vanguard|Vangaurds]]'s Prefect to attend him in [[Freidland]], where he was apparently executed forthwith ("put out of the way"), and his now-vacant post taken by someone else. Floligaiki's accession, therefore, could qualify more as a successful coup than an orderly succession.

Floligaiki's belated ceremonial entry into Rome in 851 was notably understated, on his entry to Solaum, he granted the plebs a direct gift of money. The traditional donative to the troops, however, was reduced by half.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\869 IOG - Empire of Solara Reaches its Territorial Peak.md
========================================

---
title: 869 IOG - Empire of Solara Reaches its Territorial Peak
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

Controlling most of the world's population and more territory than any empire in history before it, the Empire of [[Solara]] reaches its territorial peak in [[Dating|869 IOG]] with [[Anparashi Puli Mabosi Floligaiki Ailushi]] as its emperor, control territory in all three known lands to the Solari, [[Shul]], [[As]], [[Ararukoi]]. 


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\869 IOG - Floligaiki dies.md
========================================

---
title: 869 IOG - Floligaiki dies
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

Early in [[Dating|869 IOG]], [[Anparashi Puli Mabosi Floligaiki Ailushi|Floligaiki]] grew ill and set sail for [[Asheri]]. His health declined throughout the spring and summer of 869 IOG, possibly acknowledged to the public by the display of a bronze portrait-bust, showing an aged and emaciated man. He reached [[Heleuraca]], where he suddenly died on 22nd of Bomi 869 IOG.

Floligaiki in person could have lawfully nominated [[Anparashi Puli Floligaiki Katumokai Ailushi|Katumokai]] as his successor, but Dio claims that Floligaiki's wife, assured Katumokai's succession by keeping Floligaiki's death a secret, long enough for her to produce and sign a document attesting to Katumokai's adoption as son and successor.

Under Floligaiki, on the year of his death, Solara reached its territorial peak.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\869 IOG - Katumokai Becomes Emperor of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 869 IOG - Katumokai Becomes Emperor of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

Failure to nominate an heir could invite chaotic, destructive wresting of power by a succession of competing claimants – a civil war. Too early a nomination could be seen as an abdication and reduce the chance for an orderly transmission of power. As [[Anparashi Puli Mabosi Floligaiki Ailushi|Floligaiki]] lay dying, nursed by his wife, and closely watched by Prefect Atti, he could have lawfully adopted [[Anparashi Puli Floligaiki Katumokai Ailushi|Katumokai]] as heir by means of a simple deathbed wish, expressed before witnesses; but when an adoption document was eventually presented, it was signed not by Floligaiki but by his wife. That Katumokai was still in [[Province of Pariai|Pariai]] was a further irregularity, as [[Setting/Cultures/Solari|Solari]] adoption law required the presence of both parties at the adoption ceremony. Rumours, doubts, and speculation attended Katumokai's adoption and succession. It has been suggested that Floligaiki's young manservant, who died very soon after Floligaiki, was killed (or killed himself) rather than face awkward questions. Ancient sources are divided on the legitimacy of Katumokai's adoption: Di saw it as bogus and the another writer as genuine. A Rosisti minted early in Katumokai's reign represents the official position; it presents Katumokai as Floligaiki's "Puli" (Floligaiki's heir designate).

According to a late [[Setting/Cultures/Solari|Solari]] collection of biographies, written in [[Solari (Language)|Solari]], of the [[Solara|Solari]] emperors, their junior colleagues, designated heirs and usurpers, Katumokai informed the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] of his accession in a letter as a fait accompli, explaining that "the unseemly haste of the troops in acclaiming him emperor was due to the belief that the state could not be without an emperor". The new emperor rewarded the [[Military of Solara|Rikati]]'s loyalty with the customary bonus, and the Senate endorsed the acclamation. Various public ceremonies were organised on Katumokai's behalf, celebrating his "divine election" by all the gods, whose community now included Floligaiki, deified at Katumokai's request.

On [[Dating|24th of Bomi, 869 IOG]] Katumokai was proclaimed emperor of all Solara and adopted his name "Anparashi Puli Floligaiki Katumokai Ailushi."


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\890 IOG - Death of Katumokai.md
========================================

---
title: 890 IOG - Death of Katumokai
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Dating|20th of Ebolumi, 890 IOG]], in his villa near [[Cetum|Cetumi]] at the age of 62, having reigned for 21 years, [[Anparashi Puli Floligaiki Katumokai Ailushi|Katumokai]] dies. Contemporary writers of the time record details of his failing health.

He was buried at [[Badauli]], near Cetumi, on an estate that had once belonged to [[Kikari]]. Soon after, his remains were transferred to [[Solaum]] and buried, close to the almost-complete mausoleum. Upon completion of the [[Mausoleum of Katumokai]] in Solaum in 891 IOG by his successor [[Anparashi Puli Dati Alaui Katumokai Anatunoki Ailushi Puos|Anatunoki Puos]], his body was cremated. His ashes were placed there together with those of his wife and his first adopted son, [[Luki Alaui Puli]], who also died in 890 IOG. [[Senate of Solara|The Senate]] had been reluctant to grant Katumokai divine honours; but Anatunoki persuaded them by threatening to refuse the position of Emperor.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\800 - 900 IOG\890 IOG - The Solari Throne is Succeeded by Anatunoki Puos.md
========================================

---
title: 890 IOG - The Solari Throne is Succeeded by Anatunoki Puos
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

After acquiring much favor with [[Anparashi Puli Floligaiki Katumokai Ailushi|Katumokai]], who adopted him as his son and successor on [[Dating|25th of Solumi, 890 IOG]], after the death of his first adopted son [[Luki Alaui Puli]], on the condition that [[Anparashi Puli Dati Alaui Katumokai Anatunoki Ailushi Puos|Anatunoki]] would in turn adopt [[Narai Anani Bari]], the son of his wife's brother, and Luki, son of Luki Alaui, who afterwards became the emperors [[Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi|Nariai Azunaki]] and [[Anparashi Puli Luki Azunaki Bari Ailushi|Luki Bari]]. He also adopted (briefly) the name *Anparashi Dati Alaui Puli Anatunoki*, in preparation for his rule.

On his accession, Anatunoki's name and style became *Anparashi Puli Dati Alaui Katumokai Anatunoki Ailushi*. One of his first acts as emperor was to persuade the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] to grant divine honours to Katumokai, which they had at first refused; his efforts to persuade the Senate to grant these honours is the most likely reason given for his title of Puos (dutiful in affection).


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\900 - 1000 IOG\918 IOG - First Embassy to the Divine Empire of Daxing from the Empire of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 918 IOG - First Embassy to the Divine Empire of Daxing from the Empire of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the [[Dating|4th of Minumi 918 IOG]] the first ambassadorial mission of [[Setting/Cultures/Solari|Solari]] to the [[Divine Empire of Daxing]] was recorded as having arrived in their capital of [[Lilinlu]]. This was recorded by [[Linhua]] scholars of the time. The embassy came to [[Emperor Liuxian of Daxing|Emperor Liuxian]] from "Anadun" (Linhua: 安啊敦 **ānādūn** for *Anatun*-oki, either [[Anparashi Puli Dati Alaui Katumokai Anatunoki Ailushi Puos|Anatunoki Puos]] or [[Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi|Narai Azunaki Anatunoki]]), "king of Daxibu" ([[Solara]]). Texts state that it was the first time there had been direct contact between the two countries.

As Anatunoki Puos died in 913 IOG, leaving the empire to his adoptive son [[Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi|Narai Azunaki Anatunoki]], and the envoy arrived in 918 IOG, confusion remains about who sent the mission, given that both emperors were named "Anatunoki". The Solari mission came from the south, entering Daxing by their southern frontier. It brought presents of rhinoceros horns, ivory, and tortoise shell, probably acquired in Southern [[As]].


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\900 - 1000 IOG\913 IOG - Anatunoki Puos Dies in Contumi.md
========================================

---
title: 913 IOG - Anatunoki Puos Dies in Contumi
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

In 908 IOG, [[Anparashi Puli Dati Alaui Katumokai Anatunoki Ailushi Puos|Anatunoki Puos]] turned 70. He found it difficult to keep himself upright without stays. He started nibbling on dry bread to give him the strength to stay awake through his morning receptions.

[[Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi|Narai Azunaki]] had already been created consul with Anatunoki in 892, receiving the title of Puli, i.e., heir apparent. As Anatunoki aged, Narai took on more administrative duties. Narai's administrative duties increased again after the death, in 907, of one of Anatunoki's most trusted advisers.

Two days before his death, the biographer reports, Anatunoki was at his ancestral estate at Druremori, in [[Flova]], about twelve miles (19 km) from [[Solaum]]. He ate Alpine cheese at dinner quite greedily. In the night he vomited; he had a fever the next day. The day after that, he summoned the imperial council, and passed the state and his daughter to Narai. He then turned over, as if going to sleep, and died. His death closed out the longest reign since [[Aelius|Ailushi]] (surpassing [[Atrinoki Rai Puli Ailushi|Atrinoki]] by a couple of months). His record for the second-longest reign would be unbeaten for 168 years, until 1081 IOG when it was surpassed by [[Puli Komitani]].

Anatunoki Puos' funeral ceremonies were, in the words of the biographer, "elaborate". If his funeral followed the pattern of past funerals, his body would have been incinerated on a pyre at the [[Kambi Nariok]], while his spirit would rise to the gods' home in the heavens. However,  this was not the case: Anatunoki's body (and not his ashes) was buried in [[Anparashi Puli Floligaiki Katumokai Ailushi|Katumokai]]'s mausoleum. After a seven-day interval, Narai and [[Anparashi Puli Luki Azunaki Bari Ailushi|Luki]] nominated their father for deification. In contrast to their behaviour during Anatunoki's campaign to deify Katumokai, the senate did not oppose the emperors' wishes.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\900 - 1000 IOG\913 IOG - Both Narai Azunaki and Luki Bari Become Emperors of Solara.md
========================================

---
title: 913 IOG - Both Narai Azunaki and Luki Bari Become Emperors of Solara
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

After [[Anparashi Puli Dati Alaui Katumokai Anatunoki Ailushi Puos|Anatunoki]] died in [[Dating|913 IOG]], [[Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi|Narai]] was effectively sole ruler of [[Solara|the Empire]]. The formalities of the position would follow. The [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] would soon grant him the name [[Ailushi]] and the title [[Anparashi]], and he would soon be formally elected as [[Brili Shanmi]], chief priest of the official cults. Narai made some show of resistance: it was said that he was 'compelled' to take imperial power. This may have been a genuine 'fear of imperial power'. Narai, with his preference for the philosophic life, found the imperial office unappealing. His training as a Stoic however, had made the choice clear to him that it was his duty.

Although Narai showed no personal affection for [[Anparashi Puli Floligaiki Katumokai Ailushi|Katumokai]] (significantly, he does not thank him in the first book of his), he presumably believed it his duty to enact the man's succession plans. Thus, although the Senate planned to confirm Narai alone, he refused to take office unless [[Anparashi Puli Luki Azunaki Bari Ailushi|Luki]] received equal powers. The Senate accepted, granting Luki the imperium, the tribunician power, and the title Ailushi. Narai became, in official titulature, *Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi*; Luki, forgoing his name Gunodushi and taking Narai's family name Bari, became *Anparashi Puli Luki Azunaki Bari Ailushi*. It was the first time that [[Solara]] was ruled by two emperors.

In spite of their nominal equality, Narai held more Okitinai, or 'authority', than Luki. He had been consul once more than Luki, he had shared in Anatunoki's rule, and he alone was Brili Shanmi. It would have been clear to the public which emperor was the more senior.

Immediately after their Senate confirmation, the emperors proceeded to the camp of the [[Solaris Vanguard]]. Luki addressed the assembled troops, which then acclaimed the pair as anparashinii. Then, like every new emperor since [[Atrinoki Grudikali Puli Ailushi Freidaki|Grudikali]], Luki promised the troops a special donation. The ceremony was perhaps not entirely necessary, given that Narai's accession had been peaceful and unopposed, but it was good insurance against later military troubles. Upon his accession he also devalued the Roman currency.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\900 - 1000 IOG\932 IOG - Death of Narai Azunaki.md
========================================

---
title: 932 IOG - Death of Narai Azunaki
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Dating|17th of Narimi, 932 IOG]], age 58, [[Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi|Narai Azunaki]] dies of unknown causes in the city of [[Wiesen|Bandonomari]] ([[Hatannio Lozona Province|province of Hatannio Lozona]]). He was immediately deified and his ashes were returned to [[Solaum]], where they rested in [[Mausoleum of Katumokai|Katumokai's mausoleum]] until the [[Lieden]] sack of the city in 1172 IOG. Some scholars consider his death to be the end of the Piki Solaunak.

Narai was succeeded by his son [[Luki Alau Azunaki Gunodushi Ailushi Harakishi Solauni Ipubarinoki Anashaniki Ongidai Falashi Puos|Gunodushi]], whom he had named Puli in 918 and with whom he had jointly ruled since 929. Biological sons of the emperor, if there were any, were considered heirs; it was only the second time that a "non-adoptive" son had succeeded his father, the only other having been a century earlier when [[Anparashi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Kondobonioki]] was succeeded by his son [[Anparashi Tidi Puli Kondobonioki Ailushi|Tidi]].


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\900 - 1000 IOG\921 IOG - Death of Luki Bari.md
========================================

---
title: 921 IOG - Death of Luki Bari
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Dating|20th of Hanomi, 921 IOG]], co-emperor of [[Solara]], [[Anparashi Puli Luki Azunaki Bari Ailushi|Luki Bari]] dies of the [[Anatunoki Plague]] which was a widespread epidemic of smallpox at the time, wiping out approximately 10% of the population of the Empire of Solara.

Despite the minor differences between them, [[Anparashi Puli Narai Azunaki Anatunoki Ailushi|Narai Azunaki]] grieved the loss of his adoptive brother. He accompanied the body to [[Solaum]], where he offered games to honour his memory. After the funeral, the senate declared Bari divine.


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\900 - 1000 IOG\944 IOG - Death of Gunodushi.md
========================================

---
title: 944 IOG - Death of Gunodushi
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

On the final day of the year [[Dating|944 IOG, 28th of Shunmi]], his mistress attempted to assassinate [[Luki Alau Azunaki Gunodushi Ailushi Harakishi Solauni Ipubarinoki Anashaniki Ongidai Falashi Puos|Gunodushi]] through poisoning his food to no success. He ended up vomiting his food and avoiding poisoning. Thusly, her co-conspirators sent his wrestling partner to strangle him in his bath.

Upon his death, the [[Senate of Solara|Senate]] declared him a public enemy and restored the original name of the city of [[Solaum]] and its institutions. Statues of Gunodushi were demolished. His body was buried in the [[Mausoleum of Katumokai]].

Gunodushi's death marked the end of the [[Mabosi-Anatunoki Dynasty]]. Gunodushi was succeeded by [[Anparashi Puli Aunini Halbai Pargabioti Ailushi|Pargabioti]], whose reign was short; he became the first claimant to be usurped during the [[Year of the Five Emperors]].


========================================
FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\600 - 700 IOG\693 - 700 IOG - (Campaign 1)\693 IOG - The Original Party Land on the Villentiari Isle.md
========================================

---
title: 693 IOG - The Original Party Land on the Villentiari Isle
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

After being transported back to [[Dating|15th Narimi 693 IOG]], the original party ([[Kraven Redblade]] (Water) ,[[Lyre Hallowstream]] (Earth), [[Aelius]] (Fire), [[Alea]] (Soul), [[Bronlyl Battleale]] (Wind), [[Derf Drayniw]] (Ice), [[Thandoril Sunfire]] (Power)) awaken, dazed and confused, the party is left to wonder as to what just happened, thusly, they begin looking for answers; the circle beneath their feet has disappeared and appears to have been swallowed with grass and dirt. Their surroundings have suffered the same fate. A land that was once a camp of the Solaris Vanguard seems to have become dense forest. Upon further observation, it seems the [[Great Tent]] has also vanished following the preceding events. After a great search, they can see smoke rise above the canopy in the distance to the North. The party now has their heading.

Heading this way brings them to a relatively modern looking path in the forest. The wood has clearly been artificially cleared to make way for the cobblestone road. A road this maintained must be kept in this state by a powerful entity. They continue to follow the road towards the smoke to look for answers. This road is the best road they had walked on for a long time as it is made for heavy use.

As they continue their walk, they see a marching [[Military of Solara|rikati]] coming into view with great fires and a massive supply chain in tow. The amount of soldiers numbers in the thousands. Upon seeing the adventurers the scouts of the rikati report back to the [[Centurion]]. The centurion sends an envoy ahead to greet the travellers and asks for documentation of their residence within [[Solara]].

The envoys speaks in a [[Solari (Language)|language the party cannot understand]], except for complex vocabulary. All except Aelius who can understand the language to a basic degree. Despite this he cannot respond, he can only understand the words spoken at him. They attempt to explain that they do not have any documentation in [[Common (Language)|Common]]. This effort was not founded though and the envoy just wanders back to the rikati and informs the Centurion of the transgression and their strange language. The rikati continues its march along the path, encountering the party, attacking them unawares and capturing them for being [[Elementals]].

The rikati continues its march following the capture of their new powerful prisoners, having handcuffed them using [[Elemental Suppression Cuffs|elemental suppression cuffs]] to prevent them from using their powers. Eventually the party arrives at the [[Camp of the 20th Rikati of Solara]], near [[Ducata]]. Here the Centurion questions the party of their intentions, but cannot get a word out of them. Not liking the lack of co-operation from the party, the rikati boxes them up to be shipped to the capital of Solara, [[Solaum]].

During their travels, the party can hear lots of conversations; the sound of a horse's gallop; the onloading of their containers onto a ship; the sounds of the sea for hours; the offloading of their containers and then the sounds of a bustling city. Throughout their journey they cannot see any of the events taking place.

Suddenly, the crates open up to reveal a detention centre and another soldier of a rikati. He is carrying chains that he ties around the wrists and ankles of the prisoners, including the party. After a few days, on the 20th Narimi, he then leads the prisoners out to the execution grounds in front of the [[Dolumi Solaunao]] and the [[Obelisk of Origin]].

The great crowd, including the characters from campaign 1, around the prisoners watch in anticipation as the executioner slowly moves up the line with his axe, beheading each and every one of the prisoners. They can see drops of water come from [[Kraven Redblade|Kraven]]; mounds of solid ground try to keep [[Lyre Hallowstream|Lyre's]] feet in place; chains rattling and having a mind of their own near [[Bronlyl Battleale|Bronlyl]]; guards begin to cry near [[Alea]]; chains freeze near [[Derf Drayniw|Derf]]; all is seen as they are taken out one by one, but none has the power to escape. Slowly the executioner approaches and shouts loudly to the crowd:

>	These scum have been captured by the 20th [[Rikati]] of the Great Nation of [[Solara]] for arriving within our lands illegally without documentation and causing unrest and danger to our people by being [[Setting/Elements/index|Elementals]] of great power and using this power to attempt to destroy the 20th Rikati.

The crowd cheers and is elated by the news. They proceed to shout all sorts of obscenities and curses at the prisoners. The executioner beheads them one-by-one taking his time to take in the cheers of the crowd between each and every one.

Eventually the execution ends with the execution of [[Aelius]], unlike the rest, there was nothing that stood out about him from the rest of the people in the crowd and nothing spectacular happened. There were no cheers when he was executed, but instead just silence.

The campaign 1 party, a group of 7 different elementals, sits in the crowd wondering what they just watched until an hour later when approached by a [[Dulegan]] person called [[Kaddurix]] (who they can understand, though Kaddurix speaks oddly (for an English person he speaks Anglish)), talking of the horrors that took place and the war he's seen. He seems to talk about a [[Better Future for Solara|revolution]]. They join this revolution.

In the [[Better Future for Solara Head Quarters]] the characters are told of the horrors committed by [[Lai Puli Ozi]] and [[689 - Present - Duleganic Wars|the wars he has conducted]] against the [[Dulegan]] peoples. They discover the approximate location of [[Lai Puli Ozi]] and they set off on their pursuit while still concealing their identities.

FILE: Setting\History\After the Convergence\600 - 700 IOG\693 - 700 IOG - (Campaign 1)\694 IOG - Aelius Resurfaces.md
========================================

---
title: 694 IOG - Aelius Resurfaces
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

[[Aelius]], the [[Fire|fire]] [[Elemental|elemental]] from the original party is found to be working under [[Lai Puli Ozi]] as a [[Centurion]] for the [[1st Rikati of Solara]], which is Lai Puli Ozi's personal Rikati. As someone knowledgeable about the future of [[Solara]] and the city of [[Solaum]] due to his historical affiliation with the [[Solaris Vanguard]] in the future he is also seen as Lai Puli Ozi's advisor. He has been working under him since the day of the execution after muttering a single word to the guard in the prison: "Tsolaumiko" (meaning the vocative form of the name of the god of the city of Solaum, commonly said as a prayer before death). For this act the guard took him to Lai Puli Ozi where they questioned him and replaced him at the execution with an exact magic replica created by students of the [[Atiri Centre of Magical Excellence]]. For his service Lai Puli Ozi promised his adoption after his death and Aelius had a career in politics and military for the rest of his life.

He was discovered by the party of campaign 1 to be alive on the 25th of Ebolumi 694 IOG.

# Overview
This page contains the links to all the story points and sessions. The entire story has been planned out here, but not railroaded.
# Story Beats
- Original Party gets sent to the past, captured and executed
- New party sees the execution and gets informed of the conquests by overhearing a [[Dulegan]] tourist
- Party sets off to prevent [[Lai Puli Ozi]], the current consul of [[Solara]], from conquering the Dulegan peoples
- Lai Puli Ozi, completes his conquest of the Dulegan peoples.
- Party defeats Lai Puli Ozi, causing a civil war to break out in [[Solara]], and its transformation from a republican dictatorship into an empire.
- Party is found to be made of illegal magic users by the head of the [[Atiri Centre of Magical Excellence]] in [[Solaum]] and is told to join
- Party learns of the elements and their origins
- Party is told to travel to [[Ebbu]]
- In Ebbu party is told of [[The Convergence]] and about the second convergence
- Party is sent to do the 12 trials
	1. Medusa
	2. Elimination of the [[Kararuneme]]
	3. False Hydra in [[Setting/Nations/Echeh|Echeh]]
	4. Golden Dragon
	5. Guardian of the [[Hanging Gardens of Babaren]]
	6. [[Raru]] Kraken
	7. Sphinx in the [[Sao Desert]]
	8. Retrieval of the [[Armour of Kerekamas]]
	9. Retrieval of the [[Spear of Buni]]
	10. Retrieval of the [[Shield of Etara]]
	11. Retrieval of the [[Scales of Lug]]
	12. Destruction of the [[Obelisks of Elements]] and retrieval of the Shards
- Party is directed to [[Mount Aemi]], reach the spirit oasis at the peak and begins the ritual for [[The Convergence]]. Forcing the party to battle the gods.

The __Stormshroud Legion__ is the enemy in Tegan's Campaign. At this point in the story, what will become the __Stormshroud Legion__ is within the territory of [[Solara]]. The __Stormshroud Legion__ was founded in the settlement of [[Sotonti]], on [[Villentiari Isle]], west of the mainland.

1,000 years later, in the time of Tegan's Campaign. The __Stormshroud Legion__ is the premier force on the island after the fall of the [[Solaris Vanguard]] and the Solari Nation.


========================================
FILE: DM Notes\Story\Act 1 - The Pursuit\Session 1 - You Start at an Execution.md
========================================

---
tags:
  - Session
  - Solaum
  - BFS
  - Story
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

# Premise

Players bare witness to the death of their old characters at the hands of the [[Solara|Republic of Solara]] as each one dies something remarkable happens, their element leaves them, except when [[Aelius]] is executed, where nothing happens that is out of the ordinary.

The plaza then clears, leaving just the player characters behind where they can investigate and look around to find nothing amazing. They then find comfort in a nearby [[Trabini ip Odolumika|tavern]] where they overheard something about a [[Better Future for Solara|revolution]] from a [[Dulegan]] person.

They are then lead to join the revolution against [[Lai Puli Ozi]] and free other [[Setting/Elements/index|Elementals]]. They are informed of his current misdeeds, genocides and wars as well as his approximate whereabouts.

From this point they set off to the centre of the revolution to plot their next move.

# Scenes

- [[Solaum]]
	- Outside the [[Dolumi Solaunao]], near the [[Obelisk of Origin]].
	- [[Trabini ip Odolumika|Tavern Near the Forum]]
		- [[Better Future for Solara Head Quarters]]

# Story

The party are scattered throughout the crowd, watching the execution of the captured elementals from the future before them. They can see drops of water come from [[Kraven Redblade|Kraven]]; mounds of solid ground try to keep [[Lyre Hallowstream|Lyre's]] feet in place; chains rattling and having a mind of their own near [[Bronlyl Battleale|Bronlyl]]; guards begin to cry near [[Alea]]; chains freeze near [[Derf Drayniw|Derf]]; all is seen as they are taken out one by one, but none has the power to escape. Slowly the executioner approaches and shouts loudly to the crowd:

>	These scum have been captured by the 20th [[Rikati]] of the Great Nation of [[Solara]] for arriving within our lands illegally without documentation and causing unrest and danger to our people by being [[Setting/Elements/index|Elementals]] of great power and using this power to attempt to destroy the 20th Rikati.

The crowd cheers and is elated by the news. They proceed to shout all sorts of obscenities and curses at the prisoners. The executioner beheads them one-by-one taking his time to take in the cheers of the crowd between each and every one.

Eventually the execution ends with the execution of [[Aelius]], unlike the rest, there was nothing that stood out about him from the rest of the people in the crowd and nothing spectacular happened. There were no cheers when he was executed, but instead just silence.

An hour passes and the square outside the [[Dolumi Solaunao]] and beneath the [[Obelisk of Origin]] clears. It turns back to the way it is on a normal day and all who are left are the main party.

The players are then allowed to explore outside the [[Dolumi Solaunao|Forum]] as they wish. Any insight, perception or investigation checks will reveal information on the obelisk and or forum as they roll including colours, feeling about the obelisk and anything else. The obelisk only seems to respond to the player with the [[Power]] [[Setting/Elements/index|Element]] who hears voices in pain from it, particularly the voice of [[Thandoril Sunfire]] stands out, despite not yet being born.

Near the Forum the players spot [[Trabini ip Odolumika|a building labelled "Odolumika"]] or "by the forum" in [[Solari (Language)|Solari]]. Within this building the players enter a role-playing mode where they talk about what they saw, after some time the players begin to overhear the table next to them. It's a [[Dulegan]] person called [[Kaddurix]] (who they can understand, though they speak weirdly), talking of the horrors that took place and the war he's seen. He seems to talk about a [[Better Future for Solara|revolution]]. The players, intrigued are prompted to talk to him. He says he will only talk further if they agree to join his cause. With this they become part of the revolution and are taken downstairs to a secret room.

In the [[Better Future for Solara Head Quarters]] downstairs below the tavern the characters are told of the horrors committed by [[Lai Puli Ozi]] and [[689 - Present - Duleganic Wars|the wars he has conducted]] against the [[Dulegan]] peoples, including the subjugation of a hometown of one of the characters. It is here they will discover the approximate location of [[Lai Puli Ozi]] and they set off on their pursuit while still concealing their identities.

The party leaves the tavern and try to navigate out of [[Solaum]].

# Story Beats

- Party re-watches the execution of their old characters from the perspective of the audience.
- Audience clears and time cuts to evening where the square is almost empty.
- Party can explore the [[Dolumi Solaunao|Forum]] exterior.
- Party can enter the [[Trabini ip Odolumika]].
- Party meet [[Kaddurix]].
- Party join the [[Better Future for Solara]].
- Party discover the [[Better Future for Solara Head Quarters]].
- Party learn about the [[689 - Present - Duleganic Wars|Duleganic Wars]].
- Party leave [[Solaum]].

# Characters

- The Party
- The Old Party
	- [[Aelius]] (fake)
	- [[Alea]]
	- [[Bronlyl Battleale]]
	- [[Derf Drayniw]]
	- [[Kraven Redblade]]
	- [[Lyre Hallowstream]]
- [[Thandoril Sunfire]] (Heard from Obelisk)
- [[Better Future for Solara]]
	- [[Kaddurix]]
- [[Solara]]
	- [[Lai Puli Ozi]] (Mentioned)


========================================
FILE: DM Notes\Story\Act 1 - The Pursuit\Session 2 - Leaving Solaum.md
========================================

---
title: Session 2 - Leaving Solaum
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

# Premise
The party, now informed of [[689 - Present - Duleganic Wars|The Duleganic Wars]] and [[Lai Puli Ozi]]'s whereabouts by [[Kaddurix]], set off to pursue the dictator. They are navigating their way out of [[Solaum]] by heading east towards [[Condobonia]], their first major stop. Along the way they stop at a nearby [[Shtaduli ip Oshkaro|hostelry]] within the [[Shkari Surbaiko]] for some rest after a long day of travel.

# Scenes
- [[Solaum]]
	- Outside the [[Dolumi Solaunao]]
		- [[Trabini ip Odolumika]] (exterior)
	- [[Asolaumk Gardens]]
	- [[Buno Walls]]
	- [[Rivino Walls]]
- Within the [[Shkari Surbaiko]]
	- [[Shtaduli ip Oshkaro]]
# Story
The players have now departed the [[Better Future for Solara Head Quarters]] and by extension the [[Trabini ip Odolumika]] and stand in front of the [[Dolumi Solaunao]]. They now are greeted by the beginnings of a market in the forum square in the morning where they can shop for their upcoming travel out of the city. Here they are able to buy some departure papers off of a rogue down a back alley, allowing safe passage out of the [[Buno Walls|Inner Walls]]

They are then prompted to take the north-eastern major road out of the city towards [[Condobonia]]. Following this road leads them to the [[Asolaumk Gardens]] where they will be greeted with another market and a giant temple they are free to explore.

Travelling past they are greeted by guards at the [[Buno Walls|Inner Walls of Buni]] where they are asked for their papers to leave, if they do not have valid papers they will have to fight, out maneuverer or persuade the guards of their intentions.

Having passed the Buno Walls, the party then proceeds to pass the outer [[Rivino Walls]] where they encounter another set of guards asking again for papers to depart [[Solaum]], the party do not have valid papers for this and end up in an engagement. Upon passing this engagement the party must run to a safehouse out of Solaum.

After a tiresome journey the party arrive at the [[Shtaduli ip Oshkaro|hostelry]]. Here they are granted some respite and some food. During their stay here they will hear of some side quests and some information to be given about the ongoing [[689 - Present - Duleganic Wars|Duleganic Wars]] and the advances of [[Lai Puli Ozi]].

The players are reminded that they are still in the territory of [[Solara]] and magic is still illegal when they see a [[Military of Solara|Rikatuni]] arrest another elemental.
# Story Beats

- Party leave the [[Better Future for Solara Head Quarters]] and [[Trabini ip Odolumika]]
- The party do some shopping at the market in-front of the [[Dolumi Solaunao]] in the forum square.
	- The party, here, have the option to buy papers to leave the Inner walls, but not the outer walls. (This is not told to them, they are told that the papers will allow them to leave the inner walls, the outer walls are not mentioned).
		- If they do not buy these papers they have an earlier encounter at the inner walls.
	- They can buy other travelling equipment using the money gifted to them by [[Kaddurix]].
- The party pass the [[Asolaumk Gardens]], there is market day on here too. The wares are largely similar, but more expensive.
	- There is also a temple here where they can learn more about the [[Solari Religion]].
- Continuing along the road leads them to the [[Buno Walls]].
	- They are asked for papers to leave here. If they cannot present them they have three options:
		- Bribe: Any bribe in excess of 6 [[Rosist]] (equivalent to 3 Gold) is considered acceptable (this is the same price as the amount of money the entire party is given minus the price of the papers). This can be lowered with a Charisma DC of 22 (the guard will be either Hostile or Indifferent to the party).
			- Intimidation would not be an acceptable choice here. The guards are simply too disciplined, experienced and battle hardened to become intimidated by lowly adventurers.
		- Fight: Enter combat, they are not killed in this combat but are instead captured and imprisoned.
		- Leave: The party can leave and can attempt to climb the walls, in essence circumnavigating the guards.
- They pass the numerous, less fortunate, slums of [[Solaum]] on the way out. They then encounter the [[Rivino Walls]].
	- Here they face an encounter with a set of guards, ensuring no illegals enter or leave Solaum, the prize jewel of [[Solara]].
	- In this encounter they have to fight and flee. They cannot reasonably beat these guards as they wear enchanted armour.
- While fleeing the characters are under pressure to keep running. They then end up at the [[Shtaduli ip Oshkaro|hostelry]] where they can accept various side quests, check the notice board and talk to fellow travellers.
	- Some travellers are [[Dulegan]] refugees and have stories to tell about the war and the current whereabouts and route of [[Lai Puli Ozi]] and his [[Military of Solara|rikati]].
- Once done talking to everyone two [[Military of Solara|rikatuni]] burst in and demand to know the whereabouts of a particular traveller and say they need to arrest him as he is an elemental. The elemental stands and begins to attack them with fire, but he is immediately countered, slammed to the floor and dragged away.
# Characters

FILE: DM Notes\Story\Prologue\Session 0 - Character Creation.md
========================================

---
tags:
  - Session
password: HIDE_FROM_PLAYERS
---

# Overview
Players are here to collaboratively create their characters and are given some setting background.

# Information Supplied
- Culture Overview Pages (History and Lore censored)
- Religion Overview Pages (History and Lore censored)
- Language Overview Pages (History and Lore censored)
- Solaum Elemental Politics (History and Lore censored)
- Solaum Race Poltiics (History and Lore censored)

# Limitations on Player Characters
## Languages
Player Characters are not allowed to be fully proficient in [[Solari (Language)|Solari]], but they are allowed to understand it. They are also not allowed to understand the following languages, though exceptions may apply:
- [[Aeikas]],
- [[Ebibu]],
- [[Ek]]
## Cultures
Player Characters are not allowed to be [[Setting/Cultures/Solari|Solari]], [[Setting/Cultures/Qatha]], [[Setting/Cultures/Aeia]], or [[Setting/Cultures/Kufa]]. Players are encouraged to be of a [[Setting/Cultures/Freiburg]] OR [[Setting/Cultures/Dulegan]] culture.
## Race
Due to race politics in [[Solara]] the player characters are allowed to be whatever race they want, but they have to be humanoid and have to have a good disguise to make them appear human at all times. Elves, dwarves and halflings do not have this limitation but may be seen as lesser and an oddity.
## Elements
All players will be assigned an element at random. They are aware of their powers and which powers they have, but not which one others players have. [[Setting/Elements/index|Elements]] and [[Setting/Elements/index|elementals]] are outlawed in Solara, there is also rampant propaganda, and players are aware of this. All magic is also outlawed in Solara unless a person has a [[License to use Magic|magic license]].
